intro: Philippians is a letter of joy, written by Paul while he sat in prison.
Chapters one and two: Paul's joy in the gospel, and the humility of Christ, who made himself nothing. Chapters three and four: pressing on, and finding peace and contentment in every situation.
Paul wrote it to a church he loved, in the Greek city of Philippi.
Listen for: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

card.parts: Ch. 1–2: joy, and the humility of Christ | Ch. 3–4: pressing on; peace
card.key: To live is Christ (1) · The mind of Christ (2) · Rejoice (4) · I can do all things (4)
